summary: The filing is an 8-K by Morgan Stanley Capital I Inc., as registrant for the issuing entity BANK 2018-BNK14, reporting a routine special servicer appointment for a single commercial mortgage loan (Anderson Towne Center) under the BANK 2018-BNK13 PSA. Effective May 7, 2026, Torchlight Loan Services replaces Mount Street as special servicer, appointed by the directing certificateholder Deer Park Road Management. There are no changes to deal structures, no announced capital returns, M&A activity, or strategic events. This is an operational servicing notice with no special-situation implications.
